clusters.state_of_play: A total solar eclipse — the only one of 2026 and Spain's first in over a century — occurred on Aug. 12, 2026, with a path of totality crossing Greenland, Iceland, and northern Spain (approx. 2 min totality). Tens of millions across western Europe, including the UK and Iceland, witnessed the event, with more than 90% of the Sun covered in the UK and more than 95% in Cornwall. Thousands flocked to viewing spots including Sasamón, Spain; trains were packed and carpools booked. Tourist surges hit small Spanish and European towns, with hotel prices in Spain and Iceland exceeding $1,000/night, though Iceland hotels cut rates closer to the date. On-the-ground reporters included CBS News meteorologist Rob Marciano in Mallorca, France 24's Sarah Morris in Segovia, NBC News's Gadi Schwartz, and eclipse chaser Chris Orion in Sasamón. Scientists also used the eclipse for solar research. Last comparable eclipse visible from European mainland was 1999. Thursday's UK newspaper front pages were dominated by the eclipse.

clusters.state_of_play: A total solar eclipse — the only one of 2026 and Spain's first in over a century — occurred on Aug. 12, 2026, with a path of totality crossing Greenland, Iceland, and northern Spain (approx. 2 min totality). Tens of millions across western Europe, including the UK and Iceland, witnessed the event, with more than 90% of the Sun covered in the UK and more than 95% in Cornwall. Thousands flocked to viewing spots including Sasamón, Spain; trains were packed and carpools booked. Tourist surges hit small Spanish and European towns, with hotel prices in Spain and Iceland exceeding $1,000/night, though Iceland hotels cut rates closer to the date. On-the-ground reporters included CBS News meteorologist Rob Marciano in Mallorca, France 24's Sarah Morris in Segovia, NBC News's Gadi Schwartz, and eclipse chaser Chris Orion in Sasamón. Scientists also used the eclipse for solar research. Last comparable eclipse visible from European mainland was 1999. Thursday's UK newspaper front pages were dominated by the eclipse.
